nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_step: A small blast under your heels throws you up to 7 blocks forward; everything you pass through is hit and shoved. Damage scales with the book's mastery and size.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.flash_bang: A bright burst around you hits up to four foes within 4 blocks and blinds them for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.powder_burst: Black powder goes off in front of you: a 6 block cone of small blasts that shoves every foe in it back.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.delayed_charge: Plants a charge where you aim; two seconds later it goes off in 4.5 blocks for about a third more than a normal mid hit, burning and throwing foes back.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.shockwave_ring: A pressure wave rolls out 6 blocks from you, hitting up to six foes and throwing them back and up.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.cluster_bomb: Four small bombs fan out from your hand; each one that lands blows up on its target and sets it alight for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_ward: Wraps you in reactive plates for 10 seconds: two extra hearts of absorption, and anything that hits you in melee is hurt by the backblast.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.blast_leap: You detonate the ground under your feet, hurting foes within 3.5 blocks, and ride the blast high and forward, then float down softly for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.carpet_blast: Five blasts walk away from you in a straight line, three blocks apart and five ticks between them, shoving whatever stands in their path.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.volatile_groun: The ground where you aim turns to powder for 5 seconds: every 1.25 seconds it blows up under everything in 5.5 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_explosion.megaton_crater: The book's heaviest charge: one huge blast at the aim point, 7 blocks wide, that burns and hurls up to ten foes. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_storm.gust_jab: A hard gust punches out in a 5 block cone and shoves up to four foes back.
nusmp.page.book_storm.static_snap: A crackling spark flies where you look and snaps on impact, hitting everything within 2.5 blocks and slowing it for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.squall_step: You ride a squall 8 blocks forward and knock aside everything on the way.
nusmp.page.book_storm.rain_curtain: A curtain of rain falls around you for 10 seconds: it douses fire (fire resistance) and soaks two hearts of damage.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thunderhead_strike: Calls a bolt out of the cloud deck onto the foe under your crosshair (28 blocks), hurting it for a bit more than a normal mid hit and slowing it.
nusmp.page.book_storm.hailstone_volley: Five hailstones fan out ahead of you; each one slows its target for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.squall_front: A wall of gale rolls 14 blocks ahead of you, 2.5 blocks wide, and drives everything in it back.
nusmp.page.book_storm.downburst: A column of cold air slams down at the aim point, hitting foes within 5 blocks and pinning them with heavy slowness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_storm.thundercloud: A small thundercloud follows you for 5 seconds and pelts everything within 6 blocks every second, lifting and pushing it.
nusmp.page.book_storm.tempest_barrage: Calls a bolt down on each of up to eight foes within 12 blocks, one after another four ticks apart.
nusmp.page.book_storm.storm_maelstrom: The whole storm collapses into one great whirl at the aim point, 8 blocks wide, that hurls up to ten foes into the air. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_whip: Snaps a bundle of threads 8 blocks ahead; everything it lashes is dragged toward you. The name echoes the Black Clover M game list, not the series.
nusmp.page.book_thread.tripwire_snare: Hidden trip threads spring up across a 5 block cone and tangle up to four foes, slowing them hard for 3 seconds (Vanessa's Trap Magic style).
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_needle: A single hard-spun thread flies straight and pins its target: a small hit and weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_cocoon: You wrap yourself in a cocoon of threads for 8 seconds: resistance, an absorption heart and a sting of thorns for whoever hits you. The name echoes the game lists, not the series.
nusmp.page.book_thread.puppet_strings: Strings settle on the foe under your crosshair (16 blocks): it is held in place for a few seconds, takes a small hit and is weakened.
nusmp.page.book_thread.silk_swing: You shoot a thread ahead and swing along it, covering up to 10 blocks at once without hitting anything: a pure move.
nusmp.page.book_thread.razor_weave: A wide net of sharpened threads sweeps a 7 block cone, cutting up to six foes and slowing them for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_thread.stitching_threads: Fine threads stitch wounds shut: you and every ally within 6 blocks recover 15 percent of their health (the healing decay applies). Grows out of her mending of clothes.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thousand_threads: Five homing threads leave your hands, each seeking a foe and hauling it a little toward you as it cuts.
nusmp.page.book_thread.thread_cage: Threads rise in a ring of 5 blocks at the aim point and close over up to eight foes: damage, heavy slowness and weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_thread.crimson_loom: A great red web is woven at the aim point, 8 blocks wide: up to ten foes are hurt, hauled toward its centre and slowed for 4 seconds. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_magma.ember_splash: A spray of molten droplets across a 5 block cone burns every foe it touches for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_magma.lava_whip: A lash of liquid rock cracks 9 blocks ahead and sets whatever it strikes alight.
nusmp.page.book_magma.molten_stride: You skate 6 blocks on a slick of lava, burning anything you pass through.
nusmp.page.book_magma.obsidian_crust: Your skin cools to black glass for 10 seconds: resistance, fire resistance and a burn for those who strike you.
nusmp.page.book_magma.magma_geyser: A geyser of magma bursts at the aim point, lifting up to six foes within 4 blocks and burning them for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_magma.slag_shower: Five clots of slag fly out in a fan; each one that lands burns its target for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_magma.molten_fist: Your fist glows white-hot: a narrow, short blow that burns for 5 seconds and drives the foe back hard.
nusmp.page.book_magma.lava_flow: The ground splits and a river of lava runs 14 blocks ahead, 2.5 blocks wide, burning and slowing up to eight foes.
nusmp.page.book_magma.pyroclastic_surge: A rolling cloud of hot ash and gas pours across a wide 9 block cone, burning and shoving everything in it.
nusmp.page.book_magma.supervolcano: The land around you erupts in an 8 block ring: up to ten foes are burned for 6 seconds, thrown up and pushed away. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_sword.blade_flurry: A quick fan of summoned blades cuts across a 4 block cone in front of you.
nusmp.page.book_sword.sword_step: You vanish into a lunge of 6 blocks, cutting every foe on the line.
nusmp.page.book_sword.light_edge: Throws a single blade of pure light that flies straight and cuts the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_sword.crescent_wave: Releases a wide crescent of cutting force that bursts in 2.5 blocks where it lands, hurting up to six foes.
nusmp.page.book_sword.light_thrust: A needle-thin thrust of light 9 blocks long that runs through everything in a line.
nusmp.page.book_sword.blade_ward: Spectral blades circle you for 10 seconds: a little resistance, and anything that strikes you takes a cut in return.
nusmp.page.book_sword.rising_cleave: An upward cleave that cuts a 4.5 block cone and throws the foes it catches into the air.
nusmp.page.book_sword.sword_storm: A ring of summoned swords whirls around you for 5 seconds and cuts everything within 5 blocks every second.
nusmp.page.book_sword.skyfall_blades: Swords fall out of a rift above the aim point in five places around it, four ticks apart, each cutting the foes beneath it.
nusmp.page.book_sword.sovereign_blade: One enormous blade of light cuts a lane 20 blocks long and 2.5 wide through up to ten foes. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.leg_streng: Reinforces your legs for 8 seconds: Speed II and Jump Boost II, and your next blows hit a little harder.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.rushing_fi: You close 5 blocks in one reinforced step and drive a fist through whoever is in the way.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.reinforced: Hardens your whole body for 5 seconds: Resistance II.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.arm_streng: Reinforces your arms for 10 seconds: Strength II and a bonus on every melee blow. Named after the Leg Strength Boost; not a wiki page.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.shoulder_c: You barge 8 blocks forward shoulder first, hurting and throwing aside everything on the way.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.rising_kic: A reinforced kick from below that lifts every foe in a short 3.5 block cone off the ground.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.ironclad_b: Your skin turns hard as iron for 11 seconds: resistance, an absorption heart and thorns against whoever hits you.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.fist_barra: Six punches in under a second on the foe in front of you (within 5 blocks); together they hit for about one and a half zone hits.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.skyfall_sm: You jump high, then crash down fist first: foes within 5.5 blocks of the landing are hurt and thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_reinforcement.titan_body: Reinforces every muscle for 14 seconds: Strength II, Resistance II, Speed I and a large bonus on every melee blow. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_fire.flame_rope_binding_: A rope of flame ties up the foe under your crosshair (14 blocks): a small burning hit and a short hold.
nusmp.page.book_fire.gamblers_base_run: Flame around your legs launches you 8 blocks forward in a straight sprint that scorches whatever you pass.
nusmp.page.book_fire.cinder_jab: A short burning jab at close range: a narrow 4 block cone that scorches and shoves.
nusmp.page.book_fire.prison_kill_bucksho: Five exploding fireballs seek out separate foes and strike from different angles, burning each for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.smoulder_veil: A veil of embers wraps you for 10 seconds: fire resistance and a burn for anyone who strikes you in melee.
nusmp.page.book_fire.purgatory_cremation: The flames around you burn hotter and hotter for 5 seconds: every second they sear everything within 5 blocks and set it alight for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.flame_lightning_exp: Flame and lightning fused into one beam 18 blocks long that burns and throws back up to eight foes. Played alone it is the flame half of the union.
nusmp.page.book_fire.excelitius_leonum: The spirits of fallen comrades rise as four lions of flame that run down separate foes and burn them for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fire.purgatory_flame_bur: Coats your body in the fiercest flame for 15 seconds: fire resistance, Strength I, thorns and a large bonus on every melee blow. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_star.quartile_flagellum: A line of starlight joins four stars and is swung like a whip across an 8 block cone, lighting up every foe it touches.
nusmp.page.book_star.twinkle_dart: One bright star-dart that flies straight and marks its target with a glow for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_conjunction: You step to the point beneath one of your stars, up to 12 blocks ahead, without hitting anything.
nusmp.page.book_star.never_never_land: A field of starlight over 8 blocks makes you faster and stronger for 10 seconds while the foes inside are weakened and slowed. A solo reading of a union spell.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_beam: A beam of starlight 16 blocks long that hurts everything in a line and makes it glow for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.star_chain: A chain of stars binds the foe under your crosshair (18 blocks): a small hit, a short hold and a glow for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.orbit_barrage: Five small stars leave your orbit and home in on separate foes, making each glow for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_star.stardust_field: Stardust drifts down over the aim point for 5 seconds; everything within 5 blocks is hurt every second, slowed and lit up.
nusmp.page.book_star.meteor_swarm: Six meteors fall around the aim point, six ticks apart, each blasting the foes beneath it. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.spark_shot: A condensed bolt flies where you look and bursts in 2 blocks, slowing what it hits for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.volt_step: You turn into a streak of lightning for 7 blocks and shock everything on the line.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_arrow: A single arrow of lightning crosses 22 blocks in an instant and goes through everything in a line.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.lightning_stom: You stamp the ground and lightning runs out through it: foes within 4 blocks are shocked, shoved and slowed for 2 seconds. The name echoes a Black Clover M skill.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.static_aegis: Arcs of static coil round you for 10 seconds: Speed I and a shock for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.volt_barrage: Five homing bolts leap from your hands, each seeking a different foe and slowing it for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunderstorm_f: A storm crackles over the aim point for 5 seconds, striking everything within 6 blocks every second and slowing it.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.judgment_bolt: One vast bolt tears a lane 24 blocks long and 2.5 wide, hurting up to ten foes and slowing them for 3 seconds. Needs Senior rank.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.cinder_lash: A lash of black flame cracks across a 6 block cone, burning for 4 seconds and sapping strength.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.soul_brand: A bolt of demon fire burns a brand into whatever it hits: a 3 block burst, 6 seconds of burning and Weakness II.
nusmp.page.book_demon_fire.inferno_gate: A gate of black flame opens at the aim point for 5 seconds and scorches everything within 5 blocks every second.
